focus: Neutral-card and exposure labels, unsupported-state meaning, exact accessibility values; general formatter internals excluded.

checks.result: Read AGENTS.md, all eight named startup documents, and docs/acceptance/m02-m03-code.md. Applied source-review-only scope; no script or runtime execution.

checks.check: Card scientific meaning and relative exposure
checks.result: NeutralCardInspector labels combined direct light and combined ideal illuminance, identifies relative 18% sRGB card and relative exposure, states the 1000 lx reference and calibration/response limitations. No claim of physical exposure calibration found.

A completed nil card produces Meter unavailable plus explanatory text that unsupported emitters invalidate the combined estimate. Pending/stale snapshots produce Updating test card instead of presenting obsolete lux. No unsupported-as-zero display found.

combinedLux accessibilityValue uses StudioNumericInput.formattedValue(card.totalLux, unit: lx, locale: locale), independent of the compact StudioMeterReadout.lux visible text. White-balance/exposure StudioSlider descriptors likewise use exact formattedValue with K/stops and locale.

StudioMeterReadout rejects negative and nonfinite values as Unavailable, preserves positive sub-resolution values with an explicit less-than bound, and normalizes negative zero in its visible readout.

Read all methods in ExactNumericReadoutTests and StudioAccessibleValueTests. Existing assertions cover exact finite bit-pattern round trips, localized digits/separators, signed zero, bounded labels and representative m/mm/K/stops/cd values; source tests do not execute the app view.

limitations: Read-only source/test review only; no Swift build, test execution, simulator, accessibility tree, screenshot, VoiceOver, or device validation performed.
